info.title: CosmeScan Public Batch Code API
info.description: Free, public, read-only REST API for decoding cosmetic, skincare, K-Beauty, and perfume batch codes across 2,375 brands. Strict fair-use rate limits apply (6 requests/minute, 30 requests/hour per IP).

get.summary: Decode a cosmetic or perfume batch code
get.description: Computes manufacturing date, unopened shelf life, age in months, freshness status, and counterfeit clone signal for a given brand and batch code.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug (e.g. dior, chanel, loreal-paris) or exact brand name.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Alphanumeric batch / lot code printed on the product (1-32 characters).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Optional output language (en, fr, es, de, it, pt, pl, ja, zh, ko, ru, ar). Defaults to en.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (6 req/min or 30 req/hour per IP)

get.summary: Search supported cosmetic and perfume brands

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (brand name, conglomerate, or category).

get.summary: Get metadata and batch code format for a single brand

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Canonical brand slug (e.g. dior, chanel, estee-lauder).
